# HST macro plan graphs generated by mckernel.dll

Each line: `ekVar = CreatePlan(type) <- inputs` followed by the parameter names set for that plan.
Branches in the C code (different toolpath styles) are flattened in source order, so alternatives
(e.g. Horizontal vs Core Roughing vs Area Clearance) appear one after another.
